=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml: Stage restored validate hints cache into workspace step (after Restore validate hints cache) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The stage-in step has no explicit if: condition aligned with the cache restore outcome, so a restore miss with leftover staging content on a persistent self-hosted runner could copy stale hints into the workspace.
  WHY: This violates the documented cache-miss-equals-fresh-start contract; GitHub-hosted runners are ephemeral and unaffected.
  Suggested minimal fix: Capture the cache restore step id and gate the stage-in on steps.<id>.outputs.cache-hit == 'true' so a verified miss always skips stage-in.
  Estimated lines changed: ~3
